title: Fort George, Grenada
scope: Standing masonry fort above the Carenage with its central parade, surviving barrack ranges, ramparts and lower approach works.
limitations: Wall tops and minor opening details are estimated. The Copernicus surface measures canopy and buildings as well as ground.
The model shows historic masonry and simplified barracks as an exterior. It excludes the hospital, modern exhibits, below-grade rooms and later restoration additions.
